C1293.title: ClawHavoc Supply Chain Poisoning Incident: AI Agent Tool Abuse Leads to System Compromise
C1293.summary: Koi Security published the ClawHavoc supply-chain poisoning attack against the OpenClaw ecosystem on February 1, 2026 and updated it on February 16. Attackers used ClickFix 2.0 social engineering, disguising prerequisite installation requirements in skill documentation to induce developers to download malicious binaries, establish reverse-shell remote control, and steal sensitive information. Koi initially reported 341 malicious Skills and later updated the count to 824, exposing supply-chain pollution risks in AI agent tool invocation.
